copy.welcomeTitle: Hello! Welcome to Dr. Kusum Lata Bhardwaj's clinic.
copy.welcomeBody: I can help you book a consultation, send a question to the clinic, or explore our women's health services. What would you like to do?
copy.contextNudge: Reading about {service}? I can help you book a consultation for it.
copy.emergencyNote: Not for emergencies — call {emergencyNumber} if you need urgent help.
copy.privacyNote: Your details are shared only with the clinic.
copy.rememberedDetails: I'll use the details you shared earlier ({details}). You can change them before confirming.

questions.serviceId: What would you like to consult Dr. Kusum Lata about? Pick one below or type your concern.
questions.consultationType: How would you like to consult the doctor?
questions.date: Which date works best for you?
questions.timeSlotId: What time do you prefer on {date}?
questions.patientName: May I have the patient's full name?
questions.patientNameInquiry: May I know your name, so the clinic can respond to you?
questions.phone: Please share a 10-digit mobile number. The clinic will confirm your appointment on it.
questions.phoneInquiry: Which mobile number should the clinic reply on?
questions.inquiry: Sure — please type your question below and the clinic team will get back to you.
questions.inquiryAboutTopic: Sure — what would you like to ask about {topic}? Type your question below.

copy.reviewAppointment: Please review your appointment request before I send it to the clinic.
copy.reviewInquiry: Please review your question before I send it to the clinic.
copy.successAppointmentBody: Thank you, {firstName}. Dr. Kusum Lata's clinic will contact you on {phone} to confirm the final appointment time.
copy.successInquiryBody: Thank you, {firstName}. The clinic team will reply to you on {phone} shortly.
copy.fees: Consultation fees aren't listed on the website. I can send your question to the clinic and they'll reply to you directly.
copy.timings: You can request a preferred slot — {slots}. The clinic confirms the exact appointment time with you.
copy.contact: You can reach the clinic team directly on call or WhatsApp.
copy.humanHandoff: Of course. You can chat with the clinic team directly on WhatsApp or give them a call.
copy.medicalAdvice: I'm not able to give medical advice in chat, but Dr. Kusum Lata can guide you properly in a consultation.
copy.emergency: If this is a medical emergency, please call {emergencyNumber} or go to the nearest hospital emergency right away. Please don't wait for a reply in chat.
copy.crisis: You don't have to go through this alone. Please reach out right now — call Tele-MANAS on {mentalHealthHelpline} (free, 24x7) or {emergencyNumber} for immediate help.
copy.caution: If the bleeding or pain is very heavy, or you feel faint, please seek emergency care immediately.
copy.unknown: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Here's what I can help you with:
copy.greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?
copy.thanks: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
copy.cancelled: No problem — I've cancelled that request. Is there anything else I can help you with?
copy.exploreIntro: Dr. Kusum Lata offers care across these areas. Tap one to see the services.
copy.reviewPrompt: Please check the details above and tap Confirm, or tell me what you'd like to change.
copy.submitError: Sorry, I couldn't send your request just now. Please try again, or send it to the clinic on WhatsApp.
copy.offline: I'm having trouble connecting right now. You can still reach the clinic on WhatsApp or by phone.
